xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Haryana State Pollution Control Board, Panchkula
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order imposing environmental compensation of Rs. 4,40,000/- (Rupees Four Lakh Forty Thousand only) for violation of environmental norms
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: M/s DEE Development Engineers Limited (Plant 2), Village Maidapur, Tatarpur, District Palwal is engaged in manufacturing of Pre-Fabrication Pipes & Fittings and falls under the Red Category in the consent management of the Board. The unit was inspected on 24.02.2024 by the field officer of the Board and samples were collected from STP. As per Analysis Report No. 2139 dated 05.03.2024, results were found exceeding the prescribed limits. The Environmental Compensation Assessment Committee, in its meeting held on 26.06.2025, finalized the levy of compensation as the unit was found to have discharged pollutants in excess of the standards prescribed under the Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986, and the consent conditions under the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 and the Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Department has alleged short payment of Goods and Services Tax of Rs. 1.53 Crores and imposed penalty of same amount for goods procured from outside India. Appeal has been filled for the same.There is no change as per the last disclosure filed in the Prospectus of the Company for Initial Public Offering.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Appeal has been cancelled by Additional commissioner. Now, Request filed by us for rectification of error apparent on record under Section 161 of CGST Act, 2007. OIA No. 62/CGST-Appeal Gurugram/LKS/2025-26 Dt. 18.06.2025
